notes:
- New Project Xfer tool (TP_pipe > Project Utilities) replaces Export Pipeline, Import Pipeline, File Xfer Assist and Project Sync: Send packages assets/shots (folders, settings, latest scenes, optional publishes/dependencies); Receive from a package or another project folder with a compare list (New / Missing tasks / Newer files / Conflict / Up to date). Still reads older packages
- Menu reorganized: Data Manager is now Create, Asset Manager section is now Asset Tools, Project Settings moved into the Project submenu, new Utility section (Set Shot Range, Save Thumbnail); Set Project Start Frame and the Customize submenu removed
- Apply Render Settings: frame range comes from the scene's shot range, else the shot's anim scene (and is set on the lighting scene), else the timeline; the camera in _rendercamera becomes the renderable camera (persp if none)
- Project Sync's background io/manifest.json tracking removed
